title: Injured Orca Found with Suspected Shotgun Wounds in Spain
summary: An Iberian orca, known as "La Abuela" or Toni, has been found with wounds consistent with shotgun pellets. Spain's Environment Ministry is investigating the incident. The orca is described as the oldest member of her pod, which numbers fewer than 40 individuals and could be threatened by the attack. Marine conservationists documented several impacts on the whale.
summary_points: An Iberian orca, "La Abuela" or Toni, was found with wounds resembling shotgun pellet impacts.
Spain's Environment Ministry has launched an investigation into the incident.
The orca is the oldest member of her pod, which has fewer than 40 individuals.
Conservationists documented multiple impacts on the whale.
The incident could pose a threat to the Iberian orca population.

sources.headline: One of world’s oldest orca whales found with possible shotgun wounds as officials launch investigation
A rare orca known as “La Abuela” was found with wounds consistent with shotgun pellets; could threaten an entire Iberian population of fewer than 40 whales
